notes.title: Server maintenance 09.13.17. Patchnotes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/292ca7abed3051688ecfa9e20997600ce7bf39b0.jpg[/img]

Server maintenance!

We will be performing server maintenance on 09.13.17 at 06:30 PDT and Star Crusade will be temporarily unavailable. At that point, all incomplete matches will be counted as a draw.

After server maintenance, you will need to update the game in order to play.
We apologize for the temporary inconvenience and thank you for your patience!

Balance changes:
Card "Techmaster Andros". Health reduced from 5 to 2. Attack reduced from 3 to 2. Cost reduced from 4 to 2
Card "Patrol Trooper". Health reduced from 4 to 3
Card "Life Advance". Cost reduced from 1 to 0
Card "Zeron". Health reduced from 6 to 3. Cost reduced from 6 to 4
Card "Swarm Sentinel". Text changed to: "SCREEN. Spend 2 ENERGY at the end of your turn and gain SWARM until the end of your next turn"
Card "Slicer". Text changed to: "ACTIVATE: All units with SOAK lose SOAK and take 1 damage. ENERGIZE 6: also all units lose BUNKER"
Card "Anti Armor Squad". Text changed to: "Ignore enemy ARMORED effects in combat. ENERGIZE 4: ACTIVATE: Target unit lose BUNKER"
Card "Anti-personnel Turret". Health reduced from 6 to 5
Card "Adept of Time". Text changed to: "ENERGIZE 3: IMPACT: Your cards cannot be REVEALED. Gains +1/+1 for every prevented REVEAL; ENERGIZE 8: Gain +1 Attack. All units lose SCREEN"
Card "Blockade Runner". Cost increased from 1 to 2
Card "The Outsider". Cost reduced from 9 to 6. Attack reduced from 7 to 6. Health reduced from 7 to 3
Card "Deathstalker Malik". Health increased from 6 to 7
Card "Council Imperial". Cost increased from 8 to 9. Attack increased from 6 to 7. Health increased from 3 to 4
Card "HK-3 Vindicator". Text changed to: "ACTIVATE:DESTROY target Aberration or Cyborg. ENERGIZE 6:DEPLOY 1/1 copy of destroyed unit"
Weapon "Payne's Rifle". Сharges reduced from 2 to 1
Weapon "Toroth's Scepter". Charges reduced from 3 to 2
Module "Shimmer". Text changed to: "You start with 15 HEALTH more. Your Commander gains VULNERABILITY"
Module "Hedronic Capacitor". Text changed to: Spend 2 ENERGY at the beginning of your turn and your Commander gains SHIELD. VULNERABILITY 1 
Module "Bone Spurs". Text changed to: Spend 2 ENERGY at the beginning of your turn and your Commander gains +1 Attack and VULNERABILITY 1 until your next turn
Module "War Lust". Cost increased from 7 to 10 energy. Text changed to: Target friendly unit gains "FURY: ASSAULT" this turn

Bugfixes:
Fixed issues with Disciple of Asag and Viromorphic Spores module combination
Card "Leviathan": now energized versions have the same group as parent card
Card "Veteran Scout": fixed issues with text of energized versions
Card "Toroth's Scepter": now ability of this weapon can be casted on enemy Commander
Card "Accelerated Bloom": fixed issues with text of energized versions
Card "Beholder": fixed issues with wrong FP when killing it with LINK activated
Card "Cytek Drone": now can be created in Fusion Mode
Fixed issue with 2 Cyphers given by combination of "Fenrik's Partisan" and "Deathstalker Malik"
Card "Kong's Blockade": fixes issues with Energized versions
Combination "Adept of Time" and "Mad Seer" now does not REVEAL player's cards
Card "Beholder": fixed issue when ENERGIZED tactic could be given
Card "Tower of Eyes": now card's ability doesn not trigger when Tower of Eyes transfers from commander to commander
Weapon "Blaster": fixed issues with inactive of the weapon
Card "Fleshborer": fixed MUTATE ability

notes.title: "Shadow of the Council" major expansion is live!
notes.content:

Shadow of the Council Trailer: https://youtu.be/C_LZh19i8oA

1.3.11 Change log:
- a whooping 119 new cards added!
- new "Council" unit type
- new "Link" game mechanic
- new keyword definition for BUNKER: "Unit cannot be targeted by tactics or modules"
- new keyword definnition for VULNERABILITY X: "Receives X extra damage from any source"

"Shadow of the Council" is our biggest expansion yet, and we have more major updates planned for the future. Thank you very much for your continued support and we hope you enjoy the new content! See you in orbit!

notes.title: The closed beta test of the "Shadow of the Council" expansion starts!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/8d54cdcf3ad4c6c11d4177ef6b954b89ff66d272.png[/img]

Star Crusaders!

08.23.17 at 05.00 PDT the closed beta test of the "Shadow of the Council" expansion starts!

We will test new game mechanics "Link", as well as over 100 new cards!
Only players who have pre-ordered "Shadow of the Council" pack or 50 "Council" boosters will be able to participate in the closed beta-testing.

To take part in the CBT you need to send a request with your game username and email address to support@starcrusadeccg.com.

When your request is confirmed, you will receive the instructions to access the test server.

The participants of the testing will be able to create bug-reports using the "Report a bug" function. Also, each player can send feedback on all aspects of the add-on. To do this, please, use the "Leave Feedback" function.

The authors of the most detailed bug-reports and reviews have a chance to get an additional reward for their main account!

Attention! All the achievements on the test server will not be transferred to the main account.

Thank you for your support! See you in orbit!

notes.title: New Ranked season (September 2017)!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/c38cd119ea72657ecc94cd64ac97beb689ffe963.png[/img]

Star Crusaders! A ranked season (August 2017) will automatically conclude on September (2017) 1st at 01:00 AM PDT.

This season, all who attained rank 28 will receive 2 boosters! In addition, we prepared some additional rewards!

Additional Rewards for Rank Achieved during Ranked Play:
• Reaching Rank 25: 1 free booster packs
• Reaching Rank 20: 2 free booster packs, 30 Farcta, "Battle Hardened" card back
• Reaching Rank 15: 3 free booster packs, 50 Fracta, "Battle Hardened" card back
• Reaching Rank 10: 4 free booster packs, 70 Fracta, "Battle Hardened" card back
• Reaching Rank 6: 5 free booster packs, 90 Fracta, "Battle Hardened" card back

Additional Rewards for top 100 players:
• Top 100-51: 3 free booster packs, 10 Fracta, "Battle Hardened" and "Battleship "Last Frontier" card backs
• Top 50-11: 5 free booster packs, 30 Fracta, "Battle Hardened" and "Battleship "Last Frontier" card backs
• Top 10-6: 7 free booster packs, 50 Fracta, "Battle Hardened", "Battleship "Last Frontier" and "Legion X-1-7" card backs
• Top 5-2: 10 free booster packs, 70 Fracta, Scrap, "Battle Hardened", "Battleship "Last Frontier" and "Legion X-1-7" card backs
• Top 1 (True Imperator): 15 free booster packs, 110 Fracta, "Imperator of the Known Expanse" card back, as well as "Battle Hardened", "Battleship "Last Frontier" and "Legion X-1-7" card backs

Depending on their rank at the conclusion of this season, players in the new season will start at rank 23-30 to fight for the Galaxy again!

All cards, factions, credits, scrap, purchases and achievements will remain on your account after the conclusion of this (and every) season.

Thank you all again for your participation and support of Star Crusade CCG!

See you in orbit!

notes.title: New game mechanics "Link"!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/af789e12e13f77a0a56fef936eff252625d6f22b.jpg[/img]


Star Crusaders! Upon the release of the "Shadow of the Council" update, new mechanics called "LINK" will be introduced to the game.

"LINK" is a synergy of "ACTIVATE" and "IMPACT" which is characteristic of Council Units. The effect can be activated and used if one of the adjacent units belongs to one of the listed types.

"LINK" effect stops working if a Council unit or another unit with the required properties was destroyed or repositioned.
If the player places a unit of the required type next to a Council unit, "LINK" will resume working.  

As an example of the work of mechanics, we would like to provide you new card which will be added to the game in one of the following updates!

Name: Embryo the Mad
Faction: Neutral
Tag: Unit
Rarity: Heroic 
Type: Council
Card Stats and Text: Costs 6. Stats 4/8. SCREEN. LINK (Aberration): Gain CRITICAL, REVENGE: Deal 2 damage to all friendly characters

Attention! This card is in development so the text and characteristics may still change.

See you in orbit!

notes.title: End of a ranked season, July 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/9a689587a04feb6530308289c442ae0fcfb5e5ea.png[/img]

Star Crusaders! A ranked season (July 2017) will automatically conclude on August (2017) 1st at 01:00 AM PDT.

This season, all who attained rank 28 will receive 2 boosters! In addition, we prepared some additional rewards!

Additional Rewards for Rank Achieved during Ranked Play:
• Reaching Rank 25: 1 free booster packs
• Reaching Rank 20: 2 free booster packs, 30 Farcta, "Battle Hardened" card back
• Reaching Rank 15: 3 free booster packs, 50 Fracta, "Battle Hardened" card back
• Reaching Rank 10: 4 free booster packs, 70 Fracta, "Battle Hardened" card back
• Reaching Rank 6: 5 free booster packs, 90 Fracta, "Battle Hardened" card back

Additional Rewards for top 100 players:
• Top 100-51: 3 free booster packs, 10 Fracta, "Battle Hardened" and "Battleship "Last Frontier" card backs
• Top 50-11: 5 free booster packs, 30 Fracta, "Battle Hardened" and "Battleship "Last Frontier" card backs
• Top 10-6: 7 free booster packs, 50 Fracta, "Battle Hardened", "Battleship "Last Frontier" and "Legion X-1-7" card backs
• Top 5-2: 10 free booster packs, 70 Fracta, Scrap, "Battle Hardened", "Battleship "Last Frontier" and "Legion X-1-7" card backs
• Top 1 (True Imperator): 15 free booster packs, 110 Fracta, "Imperator of the Known Expanse" card back, as well as "Battle Hardened", "Battleship "Last Frontier" and "Legion X-1-7" card backs

Depending on their rank at the conclusion of this season, players in the new season will start at rank 23-30 to fight for the Galaxy again!

All cards, factions, credits, scrap, purchases and achievements will remain on your account after the conclusion of this (and every) season.

Thank you all again for your participation and support of Star Crusade CCG! 

See you in orbit!

notes.title: A big content update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/68cc5fbaa9cc855af8c5dc6d477204b2b99bb4b8.jpg[/img]

Star Crusaders!

In August 2017, we plan to release a large content add-on with more than 70 new cards – Shadow of the Council!

With the release of new cards, a new type of booster – Council, containing all the new additional cards will appear in the game. You can purchase a booster of the new type once a day using credits. The price of boosters in fracta currently stays the same.

The Vraxian booster will be removed from the game. All cards from the Vraxian add-on are available in the Core booster. If at the time of the update you have leftover Vraxian boosters, they will be converted to Core boosters.

The cost of boosters in Star Crusade has remained unchanged since the release of the project. During this time, we have added multiple new ways of obtaining credits and other game assets: Exploration mode, free Crates and Daily login bonuses. That is why, with the addition of Council booster, we made a decision to revise their cost. After the update, a Core booster will cost 200 credits, and Council booster - 300 credits. While the add-on is underway, booster prices may change.

New cards from the add-on will be available for creation for scrap with increased cost.

This list of upcoming changes is not complete. Follow the news.

See you in orbit!

notes.title: Update 1.3.8
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/7071be198140ca6f3ebccda3068deb9b0dab71db.png[/img]

Star Crusaders!

Maintenance is complete and the servers are now available!

Patchnotes 1.3.8:
• You can now speed up the opening of active crates in exchange for a crate that does not fit into the storage:

*Common crate -5 minutes 
*Elite crate -10 minutes
*Paragon crate -15 minutes

• Improved user interface elements associated with enhanced cards
• Improved stability of the game client

The balance of the following 7 cards and modules has been changed: 

• Card "Hunter Seeker Drones". Attack reduced from 4 to 3. Text changed to: SHIELD. ACTIVATE: Deal 2 damage to one enemy unit and 1 damage to adjacent units
• Card "Raptor Tank". Text changed to: ARMORED. ENERGIZE 5: also gain SCREEN 
• Card "Reddow". Health increased from 1 to 3. Text changed to: MOBILITY. Gain additional attack every time you activate a Module. CANNOT be targeted by Tactics or Modules.
• Card "Lieutenant". Attack reduced from 5 to 4.
• Card "Pulse Barrage". Text changed to: Deal _1 damage to all enemies units. If you have three or more units, deal _2 instead
• Module "Consult General Staff". Cost reduced from 11 to 10 energy. Text changed to: Draw a random tactic card from your deck. Every time you use this module it's Activation costs (2) Energy more.
• Module "Auto-Repair Protocols". Text changed to: If you control only Cyborg units, they RESTORE 1 HEALTH at the end of your turn

See you in orbit!

Greetings, Star Crusaders!

We invite you to take part in the second Star Crusade "Triumphant" tournament on Saturday, 06.24.2017 (June 24)

The tournament will begin at 20.00 Moskow (GMT+3 ) 19.00 CEST (GMT +2), 10.00 PDT (GMT -7). http://prntscr.com/epwxum

Tournament will be held in the BO3 (Best of 3) format and BO5 for the first three places.

You have the opportunity to compete against other players for the following rewards:
• 1st place - 575 Fracta
• 2nd place - 220 Fracta
• 3rd place - 100 Fracta
• 4-8 places - 40 Fracta

Also, all participants will get "Triumphant 2017" cardback!

You can register under the following link: https://goodgame.ru/cup/5712/ 

Please use your IGN when registering. This is necessary for accruing rewards!

Important! Registration form is in russian (but it's very simple: registrate on site, then write your nick for tournament).

Join and test your skills in battle!

A ranked season (May 2017) will conclude on June (2017) 1st at 01:00 AM PDT.

This season, all who attained rank 28 will receive 2 boosters! In addition, we prepared some additional rewards!

Additional Rewards for Rank Achieved during Ranked Play:
Reaching Rank 25: 1 free booster packs
Reaching Rank 20: 2 free booster packs, 30 Fracta, "Battle Hardened" card back
Reaching Rank 15: 3 free booster packs, 50 Fracta, "Battle Hardened" card back
Reaching Rank 10: 4 free booster packs, 70 Fracta, "Battle Hardened" card back
Reaching Rank 6: 5 free booster packs, 90 Fracta, "Battle Hardened" card back

Additional Rewards for top 100 players:
Top 100-51: 3 free booster packs, 10 Fracta, "Battle Hardened" and "Battleship "Last Frontier" card backs

Top 10-6: 7 free booster packs, 50 Fracta, "Battle Hardened", "Battleship "Last Frontier" and "Legion X-1-7" card backs

Thank you all again for your participation and support of Star Crusade CCG!

notes.title: Balance changes!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/b5603ae2c5b736b8dc73eb77f6a581da622d4586.png[/img]

Star Crusaders! Server maintenance has concluded and Star Crusade is once again available.

Patchnotes

Balance changes of the 13 following cards and modules:
• "Heavy Infantry" card. Attack reduced from 3 to 2.
• "Rippers" card. Text changed to: At the end of your turn, gain 1 ATTACK.
• "Syndicate Enforcers" card. Text changed to: Every time you play a card deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
• "Mystic Apprentice" card. Health reduced from 3 to 2.
• "Phoenix Fighter" card. Text changed to: SOAK 2. ACTIVATE: your opponent gains (1) additional SUPPLY crate
• "Rend" card. Text changed to: Replaces your left module with "Deal 2 damage to a random enemy". Next time: add 1 extra damage
• "Fusion Bomb" card.Text changed to: DESTROY all units. Both Commanders cannot gain ENERGY this turn
• "Toxic Creeper" card. Cost increased from 0 to 1.
• "Arsenal" module. Cost increased from 6 to 8 energy.
• "Efficiency" module. Cost increased from 7 to 8 energy.
• "Compression Algorithm" module. Cost increased from 8 to 10 energy.
• "Viromorphic Spores" module. Cost increased from 12 to 14 energy.
• "Mad Minute" module. Text changed to: Select a unit with 5 or less attack. It can attack one more time. Cost reduced from 14 to 11 energy.

We wish you successful battles!

notes.title: New feature in the game - Animated Cards!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/8a397746cba730559b4411114ac9489312d0ade6.gif[/img]

Star Crusaders!

With the next update, you will have the opportunity to make some of your cards animated, as well as change the color of their frames!

Animated cards FAQ.

How to make a regular card animated?
1. You must have at least one copy of an upgradable card
2. You can modify the card in the deckbuilder. To do this, you need to go to the "Enhanced" tab and select the necessary card:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/8a57386bc69cbcdcc6b1bcdaab848dd2a4f9d7bc.png[/img]

3. You can change your card frame to gold with fracta or to other colors using special items:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/f1ed4a2b2bde927842ba0a73fa73d44adfe872c2.png[/img]

4. These items can be found in daily bonuses and crates:
• Common crate - 1 item of paint of random color
• Elite crate - 2 items of paint of random color
• Paragon crate - 3 items of paint of random color

Important:
• When you change the color of a regular card, it is replaced with an animated card
• If you have several identical cards, you can color each of them with a unique color
• You can color the card more than once, but the paint that you applied earlier will be lost

The required number of items for coloring cards of varied rarity:
• Elite - 3 items
• Heroic - 4 items
• Paragon - 5 items

Price for coloring cards in gold:
• Elite - 100 fracta
• Heroic - 125 fracta
• Paragon - 150 fracta

With the release of Update 1.3, the following cards will be available for upgrade: Titan, Material Defender, Horror of the Shade, Fleet Beacon, The Manovar, Carbonic Protector, The Restless, Soul Devourer, Replicant, Preacher

See you in orbit!

notes.title: Update 1.2.3
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/9ec996d838099f1ed61caac2c074186f8de98a18.png[/img]

Star Crusaders! 

Server maintenance has concluded and Star Crusade is once again available.

Patchnotes 1.2.3

Added commander gear:
- you can now customize your Commanders' appearance from the Player Profile (click/tap on your avatar on the top left of the screen)
- collect 3 unique sets for each commander, 8 items in each set!
- see your opponent's gear before and during battles
- maximize your Gear Score! see if you can reach 48 for each Commander!

Added daily rewards:
- login every day to get bigger and bigger rewards
- up to 28 different rewards per month!
- score unique card backs and avatars as part of the login bonuses

Added loot crates:
- you can now get loot Crates after each victory in casual and ranked mode
- chance to get Common, Elite or Paragon Crates after each victory (or from login rewards)
- each Crate has up to 3 items inside, the more rare the crate, the better the rewards!
- unlock crates to find gear for commanders, unique cards, avatars, card backs, fracta, boosters, scrap and much more 
- increase your ship's storage capacity to capture more crates when playing

Also we added:
• 11 new cards
• 10 new card backs 
• 10 new avatars

Other changes:
• Reworked various UI elements
• Fixed some game bugs

Balance changes of 5 cards and modules:
• "Contamination" module. Text change to: If you control a Geneshaper at the end of your turn, random enemy unit gains text "Deal 1 damage to this unit and spread this effect to random adjacent unit at the start of it's owner's turn". You start with 5 less HP
• "Duplicate" module. Text change to: Create a COPY of the last card drawn. It costs (2) more SUPPLY. Every time you use this module it's Activation costs (2) Energy more
• "Damage Control Protocols" module. Text chage to: If you target a textless or NULLIFIED unit with a Tactic, it gains +1/+1 and your Tactics cost (1) SUPPLY more until the end of your turn
• "Hellfire Cannon" card. Text change to: Gains +1 ATTACK if your Commander deals damage and destroys a unit. Loses 1 ATTACK if a unit isn't destroyed after that
• "Mad Minute module". Cost increased from 12 to 14 energy

notes.title: New Commander Gear Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/60df228d7c6dc8400912a702d49e8c10f83c17a0.jpg[/img]

Star Crusaders!

After server maintenance you will be able to change the appearance of all of your Commanders!

All Commanders will get access to 3 themed sets with 8 items in each!

All items for customizing your commanders can be found in Crates. Crates also contain other unique in-game items, including new avatars and card backs!

Types of crates:
Locked crates will be awarded to you for winning in the casual and ranked game modes. To get the reward you will have to unlock them. The rarer the crate – the longer it takes to unlock it.

At the moment, there are 3 types of crates:
• Standard (contains common items). Your scientists can unlock these in 4 hours.
• Elite (contains common and elite items). They have better security, so unlocking each takes 12 hours.
• Paragon (contains common, elite and Paragon items). These are the rarest and best protected containers - unlocking one of these crates takes 24 hours.

Unlocked crates can be purchased in the game store or received as daily login bonuses.

What can you get from crates?
• Gear for commanders
• Unique cards
• Avatars
• Card backs
• Fracta
• Boosters (including Vraxian ones)
• Tickets for raids
• Scrap
• Credits

See you in orbit!

notes.title: What is Fracta?
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/32ca9eaacd5957b7fd49e1340dc8168b8d54ad9c.png[/img]

Fracta is a precious resource, harvested methodically, and in the face of great peril, by the Vraxxian Clans over many centuries... but for us Star Crusaders, it is a new in-game currency, which you will use to acquire many awesome new (and existing) things throughout the game!

How can you get Fracta?

• Complete weekly missions (new mission are coming soon)!
• Find it in "Exploration" mode!
• Earn it from season rewards!
• Watch rewarded videos from your mobile devices!

Of course, the best way to get Fracta while supporting Star Crusade development directly is to buy it from the in-game store! :)

Star Crusade has always been very friendly to F2P players, and that will continue to be the case – you will still be able to use credits to buy boosters, raid tickets, and weekly cards. In the future, we will expand the different ways you could spend your credits in game.

We've also got a lot of awesome game features coming soon, and we will be adding new ways to get and spend Fracta with the coming updates.

Thanks for your support and we will see you in orbit!

notes.title: Update 1.2.2
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/851254f399d4f04596a24dc77aba746caeac0e87.jpg[/img]

Star Crusaders!

Server maintenance has concluded and Star Crusade is once again available.

Patchnotes 1.2.2:
• Now in Raid Mode you can have only one copy of module in your deck
• Reworked ingame shop. New ingame currency added - "Fracta". You can get Fracta during gameplay
• Added a number of new game effects
• Fixed some game bugs

• Balance changes of the following 12 cards and modules (including Vraxxian cards):
• "Youngmane" card. Attack reduced from 2 to 1.
• "Time Echoes" card. Create two 1/1 copies of a selected unit. The effects on the unit won't be duplicated
• "Captain's Pride" module. At the start of your turn, your Commander gains SCREEN if you have no units with SCREEN and he has more HEALTH than opponent. Commander loses SCREEN after he takes damage
• "Nergal's Gift" module. Costs reduced to 8 energy. New text of the module: If you control only CYBORG units they RESTORE 2 HEALTH at the end of your turn. You start with 5 less HEALTH
• "Auto-Repair Protocols" module. If you control only CYBORG units they RESTORE 2 HEALTH at the end of your turn. You start with 5 less HEALTH
• "Overclock Targeting Servos" module. Cost reduced from 8 to 6 energy. Take 3 damage. Your next played Tactic card costs (2) less SUPPLY
• "Plague Nexus" module. Cost increased from 6 to 9 energy. Draw a Geneshaper Apprentice card
• "Natural Selection" module. If you control 3 or more Aberrations, random one with MUTATION ability mutates at the end of your turn. You start with 5 less HEALTH
• "Infect" module. Cost increased from 7 to 9 energy.
• "Combat Engineer" card. At the end of your turn, add 1 MAX HEALTH to another random friendly unit
• "War Banner" card. Cost reduced from 3 to 2.
• "Ethereal Enlightenment" module. If you have less than 5 PSYCHIC CHARGE at the end of your turn, gain 1. You start with 10 less HEALTH

See you in orbit!

notes.title: "Exploration" mode (daily rewards)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/e364826a0832b5c662fdcf4c2c326b3d81b611cc.jpg[/img]

As of 10.31.16, Star Crusade has added a new "Exploration" mode (daily rewards). We've also added a mini guide!

How can I get daily rewards?

1) Choose "Eploration"
2) Click "Start" 
3) Your ship moves a random number of moves (1-5) up on the star map

Actions and timer:

The player may take 2 actions per day; the minimum time between an action is 2 hours 
The timer will start a countdown to the next action after your first daily action is taken 
After your final daily action, the timer will start the countdown to your next day action

Unique Feature Elements: 

"Barrier": Move your ship a random number of spaces back on the star map
"Refuel":  Your ship moves a random number of moves up on the star map
"Secret Route": Your ship crosses to a Secret Route
"Energy": The player receives an extra action per day

notes.title: Patchnotes 09.15.16
notes.content:
General Changes:
1. Fixed an issue where users Rank 26 and above very often match a game with a bot. 
2. Fixed an issue where users sometimes could not find a Raid opponent. 
3. Reduced the move timer from 120 to 80 seconds. 

Card Mechanics:
1. Fixed an issue where the Module "Master of Logistics" decreases the cost of multiple cards before taking them from the deck
2. Fixed a problem where a card's values effected by "nullify" were incorrectly calculated.
3. Fixed the mechanism of discounted Cards: A card discounted after it has been drawn and returned to a player's hand will reset to its original cost. 
4. Fixed an issue with word artifacts on the play field related to "Mutate" cards.
5. When triggered, the "Negotiate Ceasefire" Cypher no longer gives out energy for a failed hit.

Dear Star Crusaders! We apologize for the disconnects that some of you have been experiencing in the last 24 hours. We've been informed by our off-site data center that there was an issue on their end that has been force disconnecting our games, causing some games to be auto surrendered. This issue has now been corrected and we have created a special promo code, to thank you for your patience and support. Enter WarpDriveOnline in the Special Codes section in the Settings to claim it. Thank you very much!

notes.title: Star Crusade Global Launch!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11166396/9ec996d838099f1ed61caac2c074186f8de98a18.png[/img]

We are proud to announce the official release of Star Crusade CCG! After months of dialogue between our development team and our dedicated beta players, we are launching the game globally on Steam and iOS, fully voiced and localized in 7 languages, with six unique factions, 400+ cards, customizable commander modules, enhanced energy mechanics, video tutorials, detailed unit lore, player profile and avatars, improved visuals and a lot more.

If you are a new player, make sure to check out the HELP section to learn more about the game!

To connect your Steam account to iOS you need to:
(1) Launch Star Crusade from Steam, go to Settings - Account and press "Registration"
(2) Launch Star Crusade on your mobile device, go to Settings and tap Login
(3) Enter the e-mail and password you created in step (1)

As we are expecting an influx of players, we kindly ask that everyone pitches in to help and support their engagement and quick acclimation into the Star Crusade universe. Please give a warm welcome to all new and returning Star Crusaders!

Thank you for support!

notes.title: Hot-fixes 09.06.16-09.07.16. Preparing for global release
notes.content:
1. Attack of a unit with 1 attack is correctly resoted after it was under the effect of Noise Veil module.
2. Noise Veil interacts correctly with Impact and Zeal effects.
3. Contamination module is triggered if you control Master Geneshaper as well as Geneshaper Apprentice.
4. Dealing damage to a Commander with Psychic Charge is animated right.
5. Band of Brothers and Tactical Flexibility modules interract correctly. 
6. Abaku Scavenger steals energy even if dies after an attack.
7. Titans, Syndicate Enforcers and Mystic Apprentices abilities can’t target a destroyed unit.
8. Hit and Run Tactics module interacts correctly with Heavy Infantrys ability.
9. If you nullify a non-damaged unit with health decreased its health is restored. 
10. Mechanics of Fleshborer was changed: it no longer summons new one if the original Fleshborer died while destroying a unit.

notes.title: Patchnotes July, 22
notes.content:
1. "Shadow Infiltrator" can now destroy friendly unit with SCREEN.

2. "Abomination" can now get ASSAULT and IMPACT through DEVOUR ability.

3. Stats of a copy created by "Illusionary Force" are correct now.

4. Mechanics and text of "Band of Brothers" was fixed:
Before: Your Guardsmen have 0 ATK and gain +1 ATK for every other Guardsman on the board.
Now: Your Guardsmen have 0 ATK and gain +1 ATK for every other friendly Guardsman.

5. The bug related to destruction of a unit marked with "Parasitic Thrall" is fixed. 

6. "Syndicate Enforcers’" effect is now triggered by "Precision Strike", "Rampage", "Discharge", "Assimilation".

7. All cards with ability to buff a random unit can buf themselves ("Photonic Pylons", "Arsenal Dropship", "Combat Engineer", "Shock Trooper").  

9. "Phantom" doesn’t gain CLOAK when you take control over it anymore.

10. "Phantom" doesn’t give CLOAK to "Peacekeeper" when he changes side anymore.

12. "Onslaught" mechanics is fixed: "Torka Hounds" spawn now correctly. Text was changed as well:
Before: For every unit killed this turn, DEPLOY a 1/1 Torka Hound. ENERGIZE 7: each Torka Hound gains +1/+1
Now: For every unit destroyed earlier on this turn, DEPLOY a 1/1 Torka Hound. ENERGIZE 7: All your Torka Hounds gain +1/+1 

13. Nullifying "Council Patrol" no longer cancel it’s Activate effect.

14. Discharge tactic now triggers Mobile Base Ship effect.

15. "Viromorphic Spores" Module is able to give "Fleshborer" MOBILITY effect now. 

16.  INVINCIBLE effect can now protect your Commander from Fatigue damage.

17. "Wolves at the Gate" Tactic cannot give CLOAK twice to the same target anymore. 

18. Resulting SUPPLY amount is now calculated correctly after playing of SUPPLY-affecting cards. 

19. Friendly unit with BUNKER ability can now be targeted with Tactics or Unit abilities.

20. "Emanation Cypher" is not triggered by taking control of units now.

21. "Emanation Cypher" is not triggered by unit’s tranformation now. 

22. "Negotiate Ceasefire" Cypher is triggered by enemy Commander’s attacks. 

23. "Telekinesis" Cypher is not triggered by enemy Commander’s attacks when there are no units deployed. 

24. "War Footing" text was changed:
Before: All units with 3 or less SUPPLY cost, deployed this turn, gain MOBILITY.
Now: All your units with 3 or less SUPPLY cost have MOBILITY till the end of your turn.

25. "Cloning Vats" is no longer able to crash the game.

notes.title: The conclusion of the fifth ranked season of Star Crusade
notes.content:
Greetings, Star Crusaders!

The fifth ranked season of Star Crusade (May 2016) will be concluding on June 1st @ Midnight PDT.

This season, all who have reached rank 29, will receive 3 boosters! In addition, we, as always, prepared for you some extra rewards.

Additional Rewards for Rank Achieved during Ranked Play:
Reaching Rank 28:
==> 1 free booster pack
Reaching Rank 25:
==> 3 free booster packs 
Reaching Rank 20:
==> 5 free booster packs
==> "Battle Hardened" card back
Reaching Rank 15:
==> 7 free booster packs
==> 100 credits
==> "Battle Hardened" card back
Reaching Rank 10:
==> 10 free booster packs
==> 200 credits
==> "Battle Hardened" card back
Reaching Rank 6:
==> 13 free booster packs
==> 250 credits
==> "Battle Hardened" card back

Additional Rewards for top 100 players:
Top 100-51:
==> 5 free booster packs
==> "Battle Hardened" and "Disciple of the Crusade" card backs
Top 50-11:
==> 10 free booster packs
==> 50 Scrap
==> "Battle Hardened" and "Disciple of the Crusade" card backs
Top 10-6:
==> 15 free booster packs
==> 100 Scrap
==> "Battle Hardened", "Disciple of the Crusade" and "Vanguard of the Crusade" card backs
Top 5-2:
==> 20 free booster packs
==> 200 Scrap
==> "Battle Hardened", "Disciple of the Crusade" and "Vanguard of the Crusade" card backs
Top 1 (true Imperator):
==> 30 free booster packs
==> 250 Scrap
==> "Imperator of known Expance" card back, as well as "Battle Hardened", "Disciple of the Crusade" and "Vanguard of the Crusade" card backs

All cards, factions, credits, scrap, purchases and achievements will remain on your account after the conclusion of this (and every) season.

Thank you all again for your participation and for your support of the game! See you in orbit!

notes.title: Tournament Finale and Promotions
notes.content:
Greetings, Star Crusaders!

Yesterday was the exciting first day of the Star Crusade Invitational Tournament, and today we will witness its equally exciting conclusion! Tune in to Jareth's channel ([url=https://www.twitch.tv/jaretha]https://www.twitch.tv/jaretha[/url]) at 6:00 AM EST (13:00 Moscow time) to see even more stellar Star Crusade match-ups, including the road to the finals!

Three top places will receive cash prizes, all the top players will receive boosters (those who finish higher get significantly more boosters) and only one player will be declared Winner of the First Crusade.

To celebrate this awesome event, we have some promotions running through the rest of the weekend:


1. Spread the word about Star Crusade!
Help get 50 new players to Star Crusade before the conclusion of the tournament and we will create a promo code for 5 boosters, 100 scrap and 100 credits to all players (including those newcomers)! 
<===>
IMPORTANT: Make sure your friends use this link to download the game: http://starcrusade.trbt.it/firstcrusade
<===>

2. Support the game and get bonuses for real purchases!
Make any real purchase of 10 packs or more from the game store before the winner is declared and get FREE bonus packs!
- buy 10 boosters, get 2 extra ones for free!
- buy 20 boosters, get 7 extra ones for free!
- buy 50 boosters, get 25 extra ones for free!

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/jaretha]https://www.twitch.tv/jaretha[/url]

notes.title: Star Crusade Tournament and Latest Patch Notes (V1.0.2.1.S811)
notes.content:
Dear friends, on Saturday and Sunday, April 9th and 10th, starting at 3:00 AM PDT (Pacific Daylight Time), we will be holding a custom tournament, where the best Star Crusade players face off against one another. 32 crusaders will fight for the top prize and the title that goes with it. The tournament will be held according to the following rules: best of 3 conquest double elimination, two decks of different factions in the module meta.

The most interesting battles will be commentated live on Twitch, and we invite everyone to join us there -- we planned special surprises for viewers and participants alike! 

[url=www.twitch.tv/jaretha]www.twitch.tv/jaretha[/url]


Latest patch change log:
Match spectating system has been improved: now you can make your hand invisible to different level of spectators. Specific settings are located in the “Settings/Privacy” menu. 

Module: Nergal’s Gift
Change: Cost, Mechanics
Before: 9 Energy, Choose a pacified unit and deal its HP randomly split among all enemy characters
Now: 12 Energy, Choose a pacified unit and deal DMG equal to its HP randomly split among all enemy characters. The damage is capped by your max SUPPLY

Module: Visions of Glory
Change: Cost
Before: 7 Energy
Now: 9 Energy

Module: Draw Essense 
Change: Mechanics
Before: If there are two or more pacified units on board, you gain 1 PSYCHIC CHARGE at the start of your turn
Now: If there are two or more pacified units on board, you gain PSYCHIC CHARGE equal to their number at the start of your turn

Module: Trance Projector
Change: Cost
Before: 8 Energy
Now: 9 Energy

Module: Efficiency 
Change: Cost
Before: 6 Energy
Now: 9 Energy

Module: Propaganda War 
Change: Cost
Before: 7 Energy
Now: 11 Energy

Module: Traitor in the Ranks 
Change: Cost
Before: 6 Energy
Now: 8 Energy

Module: Spike Growths 
Change: Cost
Before: 7 Energy
Now: 9 Energy

Module: Raiding Parties 
Change: Mechanics
Before: Every time you deal damage to a MASSIVE unit, gain an upgrade card. You start with -5 HP
Now: Every time you deal damage to a MASSIVE unit, gain an upgrade card.

Module: Duplicate 
Change: Cost
Before: 8 Energy
Now: 12 Energy

Module: Auto-Repair Protocols 
Change: Mechanics
Before: If there are only CYBORG units on the board, they RESTORE 1 HP at the end of your turn
Now: If there are only CYBORG units on the board, they RESTORE 2 HP at the end of your turn

Module: Damage Control Protocols
Change: Mechanics
Before: If you target a textless or nullified unit with a Tactic, restores 2 HP to that unit
Now: If you target a textless or nullified unit with a Tactic, it gains +1/+1

Module: Overclock Targeting Servos 
Change: Cost
Before: 6 Energy
Now: 8 Energy
Card: Baseline Artificer
Change: Mechanics, Type
Before: IMPACT: Gain 2 ENERGY every time a unit is RESTORED, Support
Now: IMPACT: Gain 3 ENERGY every time a unit is RESTORED, no type

Module: Viromorphic Spores
Change: Cost
Before: 8 Energy
Now: 12 Energy

Module: Active Genome
Change: Cost
Before: 9 Energy
Now: 10 Energy

Module: Spontaneous Replication 
Change: Cost
Before: 6 Energy
Now: 9 Energy

Module: Plague Nexus 
Change: Cost
Before: 5 Energy
Now: 6 Energy

Module: Combined Arms
Change: Mechanics
Before: DEPLOY 1/1 Guardsman with text "+1 FIREPOWER"
Now: DEPLOY 1/1 Guardsman with an effect "+1 FIREPOWER till the end uf turn"

Module: Mad Minute
Change: Cost
Before: 8 Energy
Now: 12 Energy

Module: Tactical Flexibility  
Change: Healing exploit fixed

Card: Energized Fractal 
Change: Mechanics
Before: ACTIVATE: Gain 1 HP for every 3 Energy you have
Now: ACTIVATE: Gain 1 HP for every 4 Energy you have

Card: Vraxxian Packmaster
Change: Type, no type

Card: Conclave Stalker 
Change: Type, Aberration

Card: Rend
Change: Text: Replaces your left Module with "Deal 2 DMG". Next time: add 1 damage

Card: Treachery
Change: Cost
Before: 2 Supply
Now: 2 Supply, 1 Credit

Card: Mobilize
Change: Cost
Before: 1 Supply
Now: 2 Supply

notes.title: Conclusion of Fourth Ranked Season of Star Crusade

Greetings, Star Crusaders!

The fourth ranked season of Star Crusade (March 2016) will be concluding on April 1st @ midnight PDT (Pacific Daylight Time). As always, thank you for all those bug reports and for your patience!

notes.title: Star Crusade Update -- cards with Energize and bug fixes -- V1.0.1.18.S87
notes.content:
Balance changes (cards and modules):
Card: Ethereal Enlightenment
Change: Drawback
New version: You gain 1 PSYCHIC CHARGE at the end of your turn. You start with 15 less HP 
Old version:  You gain 1 PSYCHIC CHARGE at the end of your turn. You start with 10 less HP 

Card: Consult General Staff 
Change: Cost
New version: 11 Energy 
Old version: 8 Energy

Card: Forward base
Change: Mechanics, Stats
New version: ACTIVATE: give random friendly unit +1 FIREPOWER. IMPACT: lower the cost of one unit played per turn by FIREPOWER
Old version:  ACTIVATE: give random friendly unit +1 FIREPOWER. IMPACT: lower the cost of your units by FIREPOWER
New version: 3 HP
Old version: 4 HP

Card: Vraxxian Packmaster
Change: Type
New version: No type
Old version: Support

Card: Core Breacher Pods
Change: Cost
New version: 18 Energy
Old version: 15 Energy

New rules of energy gain:
Player starts with 0 energy. Maximum value is 40. Energy accumulates from the following sources:
1) The destruction of enemy units (gain energy equal to the unit’s supply cost)
2) Gain energy for damaging enemy commander by units and commanders (including weapons). Energy is obtained if a unit or the commander attacks or responds to attack with damage dealt. Other sources of damage do not bring energy: tactics, cards abilities, modules and so on. Energy increases by 1 per attack.
3) Gain energy by special cards and tactics.

Changes: Now you don’t get energy for the destruction of weapons and for dealing damage to a commander other than through a regular attack; also damage inflicted to the psy-shield of Commander now has no difference from damage to health.

Cards with ENERGIZE:
Wolves at the Gate - Target friendly unit gains CLOAK until your next turn. ENERGIZE 4: another random friendly unit gains CLOAK

Assimilation - Deal 1 DMG to a unit, if that kills it, add it to your hand. ENERGIZE 7: deal 2 DMG instead.

Discharge - All enemy units gain text "Recieve 1 DMG at the end of turn". ENERGIZE 12: Recieve 2 DMG instead"

Syndicate Security - ACTIVATE: If you have a mercenary unit on board gain +1 ATK. ENERGIZE 3: also gain +1 HP

Onslaught - For every unit killed this turn, DEPLOY a 1/1 Torka Hound. ENERGIZE 8: Torka Hounds gain +1/+1

Rampage - Your Commander gains ASSAULT this turn. ENERGIZE 6: also gain +1 ATK this turn

Pattern Buffer - DESTROY a friendly unit, then REDEPLOY it with +1/+1. ENERGIZE 7: REDEPLOY with +2/+2 instead

Forge Lord - ACTIVATE: the next cyborg unit deployed costs (2) less SUPPLY (min: 0). ENERGIZE 6: costs (3) less instead

Cloning Vats - DEPLOY a copy of random Aberration in play. ENERGIZE 8: DEPLOY a copy of target Aberration

Genetic Trigger - MUTATE all units. ENERGIZE 6: all friendly Aberrations gain +1/+1

Mammoth Tank - ACTIVATE: DEPLOY two 1/1 Guardsmen. ENERGIZE 6: all Guardsmen gain Emergency Bunkers

Raptor Tank - ARMORED. ENERGIZE 8: also gain SCREEN

Vraxxian Headhunter - ACTIVATE: All units lose CLOAK. ENERGIZE 6: gain ATK and HP equal to number of Cloaks revealed

Sniper - ACTIVATE: Deal 1 DMG. ENERGIZE 4: and return this unit to your hand

Fighter Ace - ACTIVATE: gain SOAK 1 if you have other units on board. ENERGIZE 4: give SOAK 1 to target friendly unit instead

Battle Tactician - ACTIVATE: All CYPHER cards cost (1) SUPPLY until the end of your turn. ENERGIZE 6: DRAW a card for every CYPHER played this turn

Bug fixes:
Aegis Defender - after being changed by Cybek Displacer, the new card was still protecting the hero
Iron Grip - the cypher could be triggered on a non-weapon attack (e.g. on Geharis’ module activation)
Duskwind Guerrilas - card’s text didn’t work
Field Medic - two copies of this card could affect the same target

We are aware of some remaining balance issues with modules. There will be an additional update in the near future that addresses the cost of a lot of energy modules. Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Star Crusade -- A Balancing Act
notes.content:
Hello, dear Star Crusaders!

I wanted to let you know that we are aware of the balancing issues that are currently happening throughout the game. We are working on a hotfix today of the main module currently responsible for the havoc -- the Terran Tactical Flexibility module -- as well as the Annunaki Ethereal Enlightment module.

We are also doing another update at the end of this week, which will include more detailed fixes, such as capping the maximum energy level at 40 and bringing the much-needed ENERGIZE mechanic to 16 cards. That update will also include several fixed and rebalanced cards, as well as tweaked module costs.

Finally, I wanted to give you some idea of what to expect in the coming weeks:
- new free starting modules for every faction
- a hyper vigilant approach to imbalanced modules (since they have a powerful and immediate effect on the game)
- rebalanced conditions for passive modules, and tweaked costs for energy modules, as well as cards with ENERGIZE mechanic 
- full (and bonus!) buyback compensation for those modules that were crafted by you and then tweaked by us!

As we continue to implement new features and improve existing ones, we want to assure you that game balance remains extremely important to us -- and though we may not get it right the first time, we will continue working on it until Star Crusade is as balanced as possible. 

To thank you all for your support, we have prepared a relief pack to help you weather the storm of missing missions and other bugs that pop up from time to time. Enter the promo code [b]HardTimes[/b] in the settings menu (before this Friday) to get immediate access to the goods -- and feel free to share this code with your friends.

Thank you for your support and your patience -- we really appreciate you guys!

- Star Crusade team

notes.title: Star Crusade -- Modules and Big Balance Update! -- V1.0.1.13.S.712
notes.content:
Hello once again, fellow Star Crusaders -- we've got a BIG update for you today! :)

=> We're proud to present to you our new Module system! Each faction will have its own modules, and each deck can have between 1 and 3 modules. Modules can be passive, which means that they will affect the game during the entire match as long as their requirements are met. Other modules can instead be activated by paying the appropriate supply cost or energy cost.

Energy is the new resource that we've added to Star Crusade. Both players start the game with 0 energy, and energy can be gained using the following methods:

1) Destroying enemy units (gain energy equal to the supply cost of the destroyed enemy unit)
2) Removal of enemy weapon (gain energy equal to the supply cost of the removed weapon)
3) Dealing damage to enemy commander (gain 1 energy for each time damage is dealt)
4) Through cards and tactics that affect energy
5) Each unused module slot generates 1 energy for its controller at the end of each turn

It is important to note that energy is not connected with the number of turns: starting or ending a turn has no effect on energy.

=> Each faction has two base modules: one that is available instantly (this was previously the commander ability) and one that becomes available when you reach level 15 for each faction commander. In total, over fifty modules are available now!

=> We've also added over 30 new unit and tactic cards to the game!

=> The following huge list of balance changes has been integrated into the game:
The Restless 5-3/6 DEVOUR: Gain ability to attack again this turn (text clarified)
Overwhelm 2 CYPHER: when the enemy plays a tactic card, all your units cost (2) less SUPPLY next turn (text changed)
Brood Eggs 1-0/3 MUTATE: DESTROY Brood Eggs and DEPLOY 3/4 Brood Ravener (now Aberration)
Council Voidliner 4-4/3 ACTIVATE: All enemy units in his hand cost 1 more SUPPLY (stats and text changed to permanent effect)
Glimmer 0-0/1 SCREEN (now Support)
Spine Spitters 3 Split 3 DMG between all enemy units; 5 DMG if you control an Aberration (text changed)
Rage Dok 5-3/4 ACTIVATE: All friendly damaged units gain +2/+1 (text changed; effect lowered)
Infiltrator 4-2/5 MOBILITY. DISABLE any character that Infiltrator attacks (text changed)
Sensor Network 2-0/3 CREDIT (1). At the beginning of your turn, swap this unit with a random one in your hand (text and stats changed)
Command Center 3-0/3 ACTIVATE: DEPLOY 1/1 Guardsman. Draw a card every time your Guardsman attacks (text changed; new ability)
Forward base 3-1/4 ACTIVATE: give random friendly unit +1 FIREPOWER. IMPACT: Lower the cost of your UNIT cards by FIREPOWER (text and stats changed, fixed lower cost for cards in hand)
Spite 2 Cypher: After your unit is attacked, all friendly units gain +2 ATK until the end of your turn (text changed)
Bombardiers 5-2/5 MOBILITY. ARMORED (text and stats changed)
Council Levy 2 CYPHER: When enemy unit attacks, all enemy TACTIC cards cost extra (5) SUPPLY until the end of his next turn (text changed)
Vraxxian Headhunter 3-3/3 ACTIVATE: All units lose CLOAK. Gain ATK and HP equal to number of units revealed (text changed)
War Footing 2 All units with 3 or less SUPPLY cost, deployed this turn gain MOBILITY (text changed)
Parasitic Thrall 3-3/3 ACTIVATE: Choose target enemy unit. When Parasitic Thrall is destroyed, TAKE CONTROL of the chosen unit. MUTATE: gain SCREEN (text changed)
Conclave Harvester 5-4/5 Activate: deal 2 DMG to all Mercenary units (stats changed)
Land Crawler 6-3/7 IMPACT: All enemy units have -1 ATK (stats changed)
Scent of Blood 3 Deal 1 DMG to a unit, adjacent units gain SWARM (cost changed; affected by Firepower)
Fleet Beacon 4-0/6 At the end of enemy turn DEPLOY a 4/4 Battlecruiser (stats changed)

notes.title: Star Crusade -- Modules and Big Balance Update! -- V1.0.1.13.S.712
notes.content:
Hello once again, fellow Star Crusaders -- we've got a BIG update for you today! :)

=> We're proud to present to you our new Module system! Each faction will have its own modules, and each deck can have between 1 and 3 modules. Modules can be passive, which means that they will affect the game during the entire match as long as their requirements are met. Other modules can instead be activated by paying the appropriate supply cost or energy cost.

Energy is the new resource that we've added to Star Crusade. Both players start the game with 0 energy, and energy can be gained using the following methods:

1) Destroying enemy units (gain energy equal to the supply cost of the destroyed enemy unit)
2) Removal of enemy weapon (gain energy equal to the supply cost of the removed weapon)
3) Dealing damage to enemy commander (gain 1 energy for each time damage is dealt)
4) Through cards and tactics that affect energy
5) Each unused module slot generates 1 energy for its controller at the end of each turn

It is important to note that energy is not connected with the number of turns: starting or ending a turn has no effect on energy.

=> Each faction has two base modules: one that is available instantly (this was previously the commander ability) and one that becomes available when you reach level 15 for each faction commander. In total, over fifty modules are available now!

notes.title: Star Crusade -- Orbital Status Update
notes.content:
Hello, fellow Star Crusaders!

We've all been very busy here working on what seems like an endless list of features, bug fixes and improvements and I wanted to take some time to update you all on what exactly is happening in the Star Crusade universe. I'll try to make an update like this every weekend so we can keep the discussion going -- but this first one is going to be a big one, since there's a lot to talk about. 

So, here we go -- these are the things we are currently working on:

1) Modules:
We are integrating the modules for all the factions now; that includes working on the new gameplay and deck user interface, creating the new module illustrations, as well as implementing and tweaking the modules themselves. Each faction will have around 7-8 modules to choose from, and each deck can include anywhere from 1 to 3 modules, so the possibilities are already very extensive. We will also likely be releasing new modules in future expansions. It's been a long time coming, but I really think you're going to like the result -- I can't wait for you to make your own custom decks using these modules.

2) iPad support: 
The other big project we've been working on is iPad (and future iPhone) support. We will be demoing the game for the press at the Game Developers Conference in San Francisco in March, and we need it to look and feel right. On top of that, we need to implement a way to allow a user to register for the game outside of Steam (on iPad) and then to allow that user to merge profiles into one account -- since Star Crusade will be fully cross-compatible, allowing you to play from your PC or iPad using the same account.

3) Balance:
We are also working on a large balance patch, which will include dozens of cards -- no faction will be left untouched, including neutral cards, and even some Paragons will be updated (I talked about some of these in our last developer interview). We also don't exactly know what's going to happen once all you fine people get your hands on the modules, so we may do another balance patch shortly after the modules are released, to address any big unforeseen balance problems.

4) Leaderboards:
We've expanded the functionality of leaderboards, and there will be five divisions, with 100 players each. Each player will be able to track his standing, wherever he is in the leaderboards, and there will be additional rewards for climbing ranks and reaching new divisions.

5) Deck sharing and importing:
This is another feature we're very excited about -- the ability to share your decks with friends or even post to the global Star Crusade database. You will have the ability to view the newest or most popular decks, browse by faction, by type of deck, or even by deck size. Then, with the click of a button, you will be able to import the deck into your own collection. Any missing cards will show up marked in the imported deck, so you can immediately decide whether you want to create or replace the needed cards. Try out popular (or strange) new decks or just use it as a starting point in your own deck creation! 

6) GDC and PAX East show planning:
We're going to have a booth at the upcoming San Francisco Game Developers Conference on March 14th through 18th -- come join us if you're in the area -- and there is a lot to prepare. We're hoping to make a splash during GDC as we get ready for simultaneous release of the game on PC and iOS. 

We're also going to have a big presence at PAX East in Boston this year -- April 22nd through 24th! We're hoping to put together some fun for the showgoers and maybe set up a live stream from the event... also a lot to prepare. :)

A few words about our update schedule: the reason why we haven't been able to roll out the updates and fixes that we've been working on piece by piece is because everything is intertwined and heavily in development. We want to get it into your hands in good condition, so we have to test the interlocking pieces thoroughly -- separately and together. Also, we finally switched over to Unity 5 and there was a ton of work dealing with artifacts and corrections from that upgrade.

We're hoping to have most of this stuff ready before GDC, and I will keep you better updated with our progress. Thank you very much for your patience and your support as we continue development -- we appreciate it!

PS: Season three of Star Crusade ranked play is ending at 11:00 PM PST on February 29th, 2016 (10:00 AM MSK on March 1st). I will make a separate announcement regarding the season rewards.

Thanks again, and see you in orbit!

notes.title: Star Crusade Update -- v1.0.0.28.S44
notes.content:
Hi guys! The new update actually hit yesterday, but since the patch notes were available from within the game itself, I actually forgot to post it here separately. 

[b]We are also aware of the bugs that are currently popping up throughout the game; we've rolled out a few hotfixes, and will continue to address these issues this week until all the new bugs are squashed![/b] Thank you for your patience while we roll out these hotfixes!


Meanwhile, here is the change log from the latest patch (apologies for the delay):

New Additions:
 - New Card Backs have been added: select the card back you want to play with in the settings menu
 - Black list: users can now be banned from sending messages, friend and duel requests
 - System notifications: user notification of critical events or communication for troubleshooting purposes
 - AFK Mode: if a player is absent from the game for a turn, his next turn will be reduced to 15 seconds; after 3 such turns, the AFK player automatically surrenders

Changes and Updates:
 - Added hints when searching for match
 - New written emotes for commanders
 - Changes in the tutorial:
  - bot deck has been changed
  - settings menu available for access during tutorial 
  - the ability to cancel or skip the tutorial at any time
 - The game automatically restores itself everytime when you find a match, or get a friend or duel request
 - Players' ranks are hidden in raid mode
 - Fusion mode is now available directly when editing your deck 
 - Icons in the history will now be located under the cards (instead of on top of the text)
 - The chat window will now remain open when switching between different screens
 - When in a match with a big rank disparity, the player with the lower rank has a bonus in changing ranks after a win
 - The ability of the Anunnaki commander can now be used on target unit to reduce that unit by 1 attack

Fixes:
 - "Elite" achievement has been fixed
 - Doppelganger now copies abilities of cards after attacking, not before
 - Delay when playing the "initiative" card is corrected
 - Bloodsworn Berserkers and Syndicate Enforcers no longer inflict damage on destroyed units
 - The description of the card "Pulse Barrage" has been udpated: now, it says "if you have three or more  units in the field, inflict 2 damage to each enemy character. If not, inflict 1 damage"
 - Corrected a bug, where Deflector Shield Operational would not activate if the attacked unit did not deal damage back
 - A bug where some cyphers were not considered tactics was fixed      
 - The description of some cards and abilities corrected

notes.title: Star Crusade Update -- Balance & Other Changes -- Thursday, January 7th
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've rolled out a new patch, which includes new missions, many card and bug fixes, as well as a big chunk of balance changes -- please see the details below. As always, thank you all for your continued support and for playing Star Crusade! :) 

[b]Changes: [/b]
- added many, many new missions! (*first to post on the forums about each new completed mission gets a special bonus from me*)
- lots of updates to card text (please keep sending those bug reports and feedback/suggestions!)

[b]Fixes:[/b] 
- Photonic Pylons no longer deploys with a phantom, non-working shield
- Mutating enemy Shan'Ti commander no longer gives that commander +2 attack on their turn
- EMP Blast can now be played on friendly units
- Disrupt Communications no longer works on weapons
- Mutagenic Growth now destroys friendly aberration at the beginning of your next turn, and not at the end of current turn
- Adrenal Overload and Entropic Organism now lower a unit's current and maximum health
- Baseline Menial can't transform into itself
- Espionage, played on an enemy unit, will now correctly draw the tactic owner's cards

[b]Balance changes:[/b] 
- Adrenal Overload: gives a unit +4/-1 (down from +4/-2) and costs 2 supply (up from 1).
- Advanced Fabrication: supply cost is now 3 (up from 2).
- Arms Merchant: supply cost is now 5 (up from 4).
- Battle Tactician: supply cost is now 2 (down from 3); attack is now 2 (down from 3).
- Carapace Armor: supply cost is now 3 (up from 2).
- Chimera: attack is now 5 (down from 6).
- Combat Engineer: stats changed to 1/2 (from 0/4).
- Command Promotion: supply cost is now 1 (up from 0).
- Deflector Shield Operational: only activates from friendly unit being attacked (previously activated from any damage to friendly unit).
- Duskwind Guerrilas: stats changed to 2/2 (from 3/3).
- Eridani Patrol: now belongs to "general" type (was "support" type previously).
- Espionage: supply cost is now 2 (up from 1).
- Fen-Fire: now belongs to "general" type (was "support" type previously).
- Financier: supply cost is now 5 (down from 6).
- Gargoyle Bomber: now belongs to "general" type (was "support" type previously).
- Infected Militia: now belongs to "aberration" type (was "general" type previously).
- Lieutenant: supply cost is now 6 (up from 5), stats changed to 5/4 (from 5/5).
- Mobile Base Ship: supply cost is now 4 (down from 5), health changed to 4 (from 5).
- Mutagenic Growth: now adds 5 attack to target aberration (used to double attack).
- Nightmarish Visage: now lowers attacking unit's attack by 5 (up from 4).
- Nyx Hound: health is now 1 (down from 2).
- Oculus: health is now 4 (down from 5).
- Ordinance Specialist: health is now 1 (down from 2).
- Precognition: supply cost is now 2 (down from 3).
- Pulse Barrage: supply cost is now 4 (up from 3).
- Pulse Rifles: supply cost is now 4 (up from 3).
- Raging Tide: supply cost is now 7 (up from 6).
- Recycling Vats: supply cost is now 4 (up from 3).
- Reinforce: supply cost is now 3 (up from 2).
- Rocket Batteries: supply cost is now 2 (up from 1).
- Saturate Fire: now deals 2 and 1 damage (down from 2 and 2 damage).
- Signal Ops: health is now 2 (up from 1).
- Spine Spitters: can only be played now if there is an aberration under the player's control on the field.
- Symbiotic Thrall: supply cost is now 6 (up from 5), health is now 2 (down from 3).
- Titan: supply cost is now 7 (down from 8).
- Tough Hide: supply cost is now 2 (up from 1).
- Vraxxian Gunboat: health is now 4 (down from 5).


Make sure to check out our top players' streams here:
Chesspieceface @ [url=http://www.twitch.tv/chesspieceface]http://www.twitch.tv/chesspieceface[/url]
ZOD @ [url=http://www.twitch.tv/zodrot]http://www.twitch.tv/zodrot[/url]

Big thanks to Chess and ZOD for your dedication to the game! 

Chesspieceface was also kind enough to offer me an opportunity to join him on the stream for a live Q&A Star Crusade session, so stay tuned for that announcement -- hopefully, you can join us there next week!


As always, please continue to post your thoughts and suggestions about the game in the forums -- remember, we need your input to make Star Crusade the best game it can be! Thank you!

notes.title: 1.0.0.22 Update -- Thursday, December 31st -- Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Happy New Year, fellow Star Crusaders!

We've rolled out an update to deal with a few of the most requested changes, just in time for the big New Year's celebration! :)

As always, thanks to all our players for your support and patience! Please see the change log below:

Changes: 
- you now get 3 bonus cards for finishing every raid, regardless of the outcome!
- more rewards for capturing planets!
- much higher chance for rare cards when composing raid team!
- you can now browse your raid trophies, including cards won, during each raid
* (share your heroic card drops from Raid on the forums and get some free loot from yours truly!) *
- defeating "triple-threat" planets should now be entirely optional (not on main path)
- revised gameplay soundtrack

Fixes: 
- Hellfire Cannon is now a 3/3/2 (2 charges instead of 3 charges) and should work properly
- Council Voidliner, Shadow Operative and Mining Complex should now be working correctly
- Infiltrator should no longer be disabling the commander for the whole match (just for one turn)
- True Striker should no longer remove cyphers from the enemy commanders when attacking (but wasn't that an awesome feature, you guys?)
- Disrupt Communications should no longer cancel played weapon cards
- Nullify should now correctly clear Disable effect

The season is almost over, so get out there and climb those ranks! Thanks again, and I'll see you in orbit!

notes.title: Star Crusade 1.0.0.18 update -- Thursday, December 24th
notes.content:
Season's Greetings and Happy Holidays from the Star Crusade team!

We have rolled out a small update to alleviate some of the issues with the game right now. Thanks, everyone, for your support and patience as we continue to wage the eternal battle against bugs both galactic and microscopic in scope. Check out the change log below!

Changes:
- new sound and visual effects when opening booster packs 
 [b]==> first one to post a screenshot of a HEROIC or PARAGON card reveal effect gets two booster packs! 
 ==> first one to post a video of this effect gets three booster packs! :)[/b]
- Raid cards are now sorted by supply cost 
- ability to toggle on and off opponent's emotes (each opponent or all emotes)
- added card trigger effect during gameplay
- added "Tactic" icon to tactic cards
- added "Back" button to Fusion mode 
- added "Beta" tag to our logo on main menu

Fixes:
- fixed issue with game hanging sometimes after opening the initial tutorial booster packs
- fixed issue with being stuck on loading screen, after exiting raid mode during deck creation
- fixed other issues with being stuck on loading screen when buying a raid entrance
- fixed issue with disconnect/reconnect loop when you try to play with a deck after melting one or more cards within that deck (the decks are now properly shown after melting cards)
- fixed visual bug with credit balance increasing after spectating a victory
- first planet of each raid will not show up as captured at the beginning of the raid
- lots of corrections of typos in cards
- fixed issue with scaling of long player nicknames

I will also update the sticky topic with a list of known bugs and issues in the "Bug Reports" subforum. We're aware that the matchmaking issue is a big one right now -- we're working on it and I will let you know when to expect the update as soon as I know!

notes.title: Star Crusade 1.0.0.18 update -- Thursday, December 24th
notes.content:
Season's Greetings and Happy Holidays from the Star Crusade team!

We have rolled out a small update to alleviate some of the issues with the game right now. Thanks, everyone, for your support and patience as we continue to wage the eternal battle against bugs both galactic and microscopic in scope. Check out the change log below!

Changes:
- new sound and visual effects when opening booster packs 
 [b]==> first one to post a screenshot of a HEROIC or PARAGON card reveal effect gets two booster packs! 
 ==> first one to post a video of this effect gets three booster packs! :)[/b]
- Raid cards are now sorted by supply cost 
- ability to toggle on and off opponent's emotes (each opponent or all emotes)
- added card trigger effect during gameplay
- added "Tactic" icon to tactic cards
- added "Back" button to Fusion mode 
- added "Beta" tag to our logo on main menu

Fixes:
- fixed issue with game hanging sometimes after opening the initial tutorial booster packs
- fixed issue with being stuck on loading screen, after exiting raid mode during deck creation
- fixed other issues with being stuck on loading screen when buying a raid entrance
- fixed issue with disconnect/reconnect loop when you try to play with a deck after melting one or more cards within that deck (the decks are now properly shown after melting cards)
- fixed visual bug with credit balance increasing after spectating a victory
- first planet of each raid will not show up as captured at the beginning of the raid
- lots of corrections of typos in cards
- fixed issue with scaling of long player nicknames

I will also update the sticky topic with a list of known bugs and issues in the "Bug Reports" subforum. We're aware that the matchmaking issue is a big one right now -- we're working on it and I will let you know when to expect the update as soon as I know!

Thanks again, and I'll see you in orbit!

notes.title: 1.0.0.12 update -- Saturday, December 19th
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Our open beta has now been live for a whooping FOUR days, and I just wanted to pass along a very big "THANK YOU" from our entire development group to you, our kick-ass Star Crusaders! 

Please continue to play the game, stay active in the forums, and file those bugs -- we read EVERYTHING, even though we may not always be able to respond to that everything right away. :) 

To keep things moving, and to deal with a few issues, we rolled out a small update early this morning. Here's the (abridged) change log:

[list]
    [*] missions should now renew every 24 hours, as intended!
    [*] separated the deck-builder and crafting tutorial from the main one to allow players to get into the game faster
    [*] removed tutorial games from list of spectatable matches (turns out, it's not that fun to watch other people play the tutorial)
    [*] added a new starter mission after the tutorial
    [*] increased overall Raid rewards
    [*] fixed the majority of the disconnect/reconnect issues
    [*] fixed and enabled Steam achievements 
    [*] corrected rare glitches with "end turn" button
    [*] fixed loss of sound/music (when multi-tasking)
    [*] fixed a glitch with the "defeat a friend" mission
    [*] updated the ability glossary to explain more of the game terms/functionality properly (we know this is still NOT good enough, we are working on improving this in the next few updates)
    [*] a few minor fixes for cards and UI elements
[/list]

I've also posted a sticky topic in the Bug Reports subforum which outlines a few of the more popular, or pesky, known issues in the game at this time.

Thanks again for playing, and we'll see you in orbit!

notes.title: Star Crusade Open Beta Release!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the official launch of the Star Crusade Open Beta through Steam Early Access!

Starting at [b]7:00 AM PST on December 15th[/b], we invite everyone to jump in and try the game!

Star Crusade is still in development, so there are plenty of bugs and missing features. But -- there are also over three hundred cards and 6 factions to unlock, several game modes to try and many opponents to defeat!

[b]The store is operational, so any purchases made during the Open Beta will be fixed to your account and will transfer over to the final release.[/b] Additionally, we have fun, custom rewards planned for those who buy booster packs during the Open Beta! :)

Please use the in-game buttons "Leave Feedback" and "Report Bug", and post questions, comments and suggestions here to help us improve the game! 

We appreciate your support! Good luck and we'll see you in the game!

- Star Crusade team
